title: USPP031605P3 - 'Ridley 1602' (Eureka Sunrise)
source_name: United States Patent and Trademark Office
summary: United States plant patent on 'Ridley 1602', application 15/732,875 filed 2018-01-09 and granted 2020-03-31. Inventor Ridley Bell, assignee Mountain Blue Orchards Pty Ltd. Breeding designation 'M14-16-02'; parentage 'Ridley 1403' (PP25,432) crossed with 'Ridley 4609', bred at Lindendale, New South Wales in 2011.
why_it_matters: Establishes that Eureka Sunrise is a genetically distinct cultivar descended from Eureka rather than a variant of it, and confirms the parent-offspring link between the two most commercially significant Mountain Blue selections.

reading.rationale: Resolves a naming hazard that would otherwise corrupt volume and price attribution.

testing.rationale: Parentage informs trial grouping but is not itself testable.

commercial_position.rationale: Confirms the depth of a single genetics lineage in world supply.
